name: wishlist
title: Wishlist
summary: Saved shopping for customers: saved items in one or more lists, price-drop and back-in-stock alerts, and shareable lists. Alerts are delivered through notifications under the customer's promotional preferences.
owns: Wishlists: a default list plus named lists, saved products with the variant and preferred offer
Saved status for product cards (heart icons)
Price-drop alerts (any drop, or below a target price) and back-in-stock alerts (optionally for one seller or variant)
Alert state: active, triggered, paused, removed, with the price or stock that triggered it
Price hints for saved items (lowest in 30 days, typical range), computed from offers.priceRange / offers.lowestPrice (no own price history)
Move to cart and share a list by link
notOwns: Sending the alert: notifications; the customer's marketing consent (wishlist alerts): customers
Prices, price history and stock: offers and inventory (read through public APIs and events)
Cart lines: cart (move to cart calls its public API)

publicApi.desc: Customer data export hook (decision: every module that keeps customer data answers the customers data export): lists, saved items with notes and alerts as plain records. Called by customers when it builds a data export

label.desc: e.g. Lowest in 30 days; Typical price $139–$165; Same price for 30 days

alerts.desc: Toggle state shown on the item card

condition.desc: e.g. Any drop below $329.00; Olive, from Trailhead Outfitters

armedAt.desc: Back-in-stock alerts: when the item was seen unavailable, so a restock can fire the alert. Null while the item has stayed in stock since the alert was switched on. Price-drop alerts: the creation time

deliveryNote.desc: e.g. Alerts arrive as notifications and email. Turn alerts off any time. These are separate from order updates.

tables.name: items
indexes: unique nulls not distinct (list_id, product_id, variant_id)

columns.armed_at: timestamptz? (back_in_stock: when what the alert follows was last seen unavailable; the alert fires only once armed)

stateMachines.name: Wishlist alert
stateMachines.notes: trigger fires when a price drop meets the condition or stock returns (debounced; one notice per alert per alertCooldownHours). Price-drop alerts rearm automatically with the new price as reference; back-in-stock alerts stay triggered until the customer rearms or removes them. pause is automatic when the product becomes unavailable for good (merged, suspended) or the customer turns off wishlist alerts in preferences.

Which products are saved (for heart icons on cards)

endpoints.desc: Saving the same product and variant twice to a list returns the existing item.

endpoints.summary: Remove a saved item (its alerts are removed too)
Move an item to another list

endpoints.desc: Uses the saved offer, or the current main offer shown on the card; the seller is never swapped silently. With expectedPrice (the price the card showed), a different current price returns OFFER_CHANGED with details { offerId, price, previousPrice, availability } and nothing is added; the app confirms and retries with the new price. The item stays saved unless removeFromList is true.

expectedPrice.desc: Price shown on the card; protects the customer from a silent price change

publishes.when: A customer removes a saved product

publishes.name: wishlist.alert.triggered
publishes.when: A price drop or back-in-stock condition is met (notifications sends it under promotional preferences)

consumes.name: offers.offer.price_changed
consumes.does: Evaluate price-drop alerts for saved offers

consumes.name: inventory.stock.changed
consumes.does: Evaluate back-in-stock alerts when available goes from 0 to positive: alerts for the offer, for the variant (variantId) and whole-product alerts (productId on the payload), narrowed by the alert's sellerId when set

consumes.name: offers.offer.status_changed
consumes.does: Evaluate back-in-stock alerts for reactivated offers; clear saved offer ids of closed offers

consumes.name: catalog.product.merged
consumes.does: Move saved items and alerts to the kept product

consumes.name: catalog.product.publication_changed
consumes.does: Pause alerts for suspended products; mark items unavailable

consumes.name: customers.account.closed
consumes.does: Delete the customer's lists, saved items and alerts (closure erases wishlist data; share links stop working)

jobs.name: wishlist.evaluate-alerts
jobs.does: Batch-evaluate alert conditions changed by recent events, apply cooldown, publish wishlist.alert.triggered. Also re-checks every active back-in-stock alert against current availability (offers and inventory.getAvailability), so a restock missed by events or skipped inside the cooldown still triggers once the cooldown has passed

settings.desc: Minimum time between notices for the same alert
Window for Lowest in N days
Smallest drop that counts for 'any drop'

LIST_LIMIT_REACHED.meaning: Too many lists or items in the list.

OUT_OF_STOCK.meaning: The item can't be added to the cart because it is out of stock.

OFFER_CHANGED.meaning: The saved offer's price or availability changed; details carry the current offer to confirm.

notes: Phase 3 (plan ch. 20 Customer growth): the module ships as a scaffold and stays off at launch; account/wishlist is marked 'coming later'.
Recently viewed belongs to customers (brief): the wishlist screen reads it from customers itself; WishlistPage does not carry it.
Alerts are promotional: notifications delivers them only if the customer allows wishlist alerts (account/notifications) and never mixes them into essential order updates.

Price hints are honest: 'Lowest in 30 days' only when the current price is the lowest in the window, from offers.priceRange(offerId, priceHintDays) (offers keeps the only price history); campaign was-prices come from promotions.referencePrice when enabled.

GraphQL: the store schema's WishlistAlert exposes sellerId (Alert.sellerId) and seller, the seller's public card (Seller) built with the shared mapper sellers exports from its contract (sellerCardOut: sellers.getStorefrontCard and getSellers, publicProfile from getStorefrontBySlug only when asked). seller is null when the alert names no seller, the seller has no public card or sellers is off (optional dependency).

Fixed limits (not settings): list names up to 60 characters, item notes up to 500 characters, GET /saved checks at most 100 product ids per call, and a shared list shows its first 100 items (no paging). Lists, items per list and active alerts are settings (maxLists, maxItemsPerList, maxActiveAlerts); every call that adds an active alert (saveItem with an alert, updateItemAlerts, createAlert, changeAlert resume or rearm) answers ALERT_LIMIT_REACHED above maxActiveAlerts.

Back-in-stock alerts fire only on a real restock: armed_at is set when the alert starts while the item is unavailable, and later whenever what it follows is seen unavailable (inventory.stock.changed to 0, an offer leaving active, or the evaluate-alerts job). An alert switched on while the item is in stock stays active but unarmed until then; rearming a triggered back-in-stock alert does the same check.
Wishlist is for signed-in customers only (decision D3): every store endpoint except the shared-list view needs a customer token.
